title: Quantifying perturbation impacts for large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Prefixing original questions with various 'Act as...' role-playing prompts (e.g., medical professions vs. random roles) and measuring the effect size and statistical significance of the resulting output distribution shifts using Distribution-Based Perturbation Analysis (DBPA).
Evaluating the sensitivity and robustness of language models by comparing output distributions across multiple paraphrased versions of the same input prompt that maintain the same underlying meaning.
